findings: _mismatches and _transition index captured full allele strings inside per-character array callbacks. This copies/scans repeated strings and can be quadratic in allele length; prefer native linear character comparison (hamming already exists) and a one-pass transition kernel.
evidence: All classification branches, missingness handling, ASCII-DNA validation and public wrappers read.

findings: _physical(tndarray) calls arr.ravel().tolist() and reconstructs Python scalar lists before creating Arrow buffers. _logical(tndarray) similarly boxes to a Python list before NumPy allocation. Shared Arrow/NumPy buffer interoperability should avoid these full scalar round trips.

Locus conversion repeatedly calls dtype.reference_genome and contigs.index; the type accessor rebuilds the complete reference mapping, so N locus literals can perform O(N * number_of_contigs) metadata work.
evidence: C Stream import/export paths use native owners without IPC or JSON transport.
rows_to_arrow constructs complete converted row containers before Arrow allocation; ordinary Python-row input is eager, whereas already-Arrow inputs preserve buffers.
Native backend capability reporting and local filesystem wrapper are explicit; no JVM fallback.
limitations: Hadoop/Hail FS remains intentionally out of scope.

findings: SwitchBuilder._finish repeats the base expression in each case rather than binding it once. Cost depends on optimizer reuse; this is a confirmed repeated-IR construction, not a demonstrated post-optimization quadratic benchmark.
evidence: Case branch ordering, branch type promotion and missing case handling read.

findings: _direct_literal_array/_dict_from_entries choose last-key-wins for syntactically literal arrays and first-key-wins for computed arrays. Reproduced identical values yielding {1:3} versus {1:2}. This deliberately reproduces an upstream constant-folding artifact; a coherent duplicate-key policy needs an explicit compatibility decision.
evidence: Set NaN membership/removal checked: contains(NaN)=True and remove(NaN) removes it; no defect claimed there.
Native grouping is used for nested set operations; unsupported key/order/reduction shapes raise explicitly.
limitations: Native collection_group, lookup and equality kernels are separate modules.

evidence: TemporaryFilename is an explicit unsupported compatibility import, not an implemented resource manager.
Default display reads n+1 rows and caches only formatted sample; negative n explicitly requests complete collect. No hidden unbounded default collect.
limitations: Native sample/limit pruning and source read counts require provider-side audit.

findings: BlockMatrix is only a constant-fill entry-table interoperability wrapper. fill accepts block_size without using or rejecting it; actual block storage/algebra is absent. Clarify/reject unsupported sizing rather than imply it controls execution.
evidence: entries constructs a lazy range table, with no full Python matrix materialization.
Key normalization, source checking, owner capture and lookup-reference deduplication read. Added validation of native declared type hints against actual lookup output schema.
limitations: Each fresh lookup call has a fresh identity; build-side execution reuse must be verified in the native planner.
Python recursive rewrites do not preserve shared DAG work automatically; global DAG compilation concern applies.

findings: nd.array delegates through arrow_literal, whose ndarray conversion boxes NumPy buffers into Python scalar lists; see arrow.py.
evidence: arange remains expression-based and attaches ndarray metadata via a native cast, rather than materializing a NumPy range.
Full variant_qc/HWE wrapper read. Row statistics remain lazy expressions, call_stats uses shared reducers, and matrix column count is a native frontend scope leaf resolved by its owner.
limitations: Genomic statistical algorithms and matrix row aggregate lowering require separate native/planner audit.

findings: _query_rows eagerly evals any non-row-indexed query key, including global-dependent expressions, while constructing the query expression. This creates an action boundary and materializes keys before normal action planning; dynamic native bounds should be bound at the owning action instead.
evidence: Row-indexed queries lower through all-matches lookup; constant intervals use pruning-aware interval filtering.
limitations: Avoided-read guarantees must be proven with provider I/O counters, not just plan shape.

findings: ReferenceGenome.__eq__ builds full mapping/list definitions for comparison; Locus validation reads the copying lengths property repeatedly and contig ordinals use tuple.index. Together with tlocus.reference_genome reconstruction this causes metadata work proportional to reference size per scalar locus. Prefer shared native immutable reference handles and cached ordinal lookup.
evidence: External JSON reference file reads are actual persisted formats, not in-memory transport. Sequence/liftover APIs explicitly reject unsupported operations.
limitations: types.py was only inspected at tlocus.reference_genome accessor; the parent owns its full review.

evidence: Complete Balding-Nichols port read, including argument validation and native lazy row/column/entry RNG construction. Generated genotypes are retained as fields before call construction to avoid repeated draws/metadata expansion.
limitations: Partition parameters remain intentionally untouched: user requested recording the partitioning divergence before implementation.
Native _generate and RNG layout performance are separate planner modules.

findings: _slice_bound(step) and _translate_dynamic build a position array and call substring/index on a captured whole string per element. This repeats full string capture/copy and Unicode traversal rather than scanning once. Dynamic translation also captures the complete dictionary per character. A typed native scalar kernel should consume string/codepoints and dictionary once.

translate evaluates a native literal dictionary through hl.eval during expression construction to recover a Python mapping. This is pure literal data, but introduces an unnecessary action/latency boundary.
evidence: UTF-8/codepoint behavior is intentional and preserved; no UTF-16 compatibility restoration requested.

limitations: Hadoop/Hail FS support is intentionally excluded.

split_multi_hts builds and rescans the original O(A^2) genotype PL coordinates for each of A split alleles, yielding O(A^3) work relative to O(A^2) input. Native shared downcoding can compute incident minima and the few excluded-allele minima once per original variant.
evidence: PL diploid/haploid branches, GT/PGT downcoding, AD/GQ updates and symbolic allele behavior read. Table/VEP support is explicitly unavailable.
